definitions: A user interface element, often found in software applications or web browsers, that, when selected, displays information or tools related to looking up definitions, translations, or other reference material.
A specific section or feature within a digital interface designed to facilitate the search and retrieval of information, typically for definitions, synonyms, or contextual details.
examples: Click the Look Up tab to find the meaning of the word.
The Look Up tab in the e-reader provides instant definitions.
I always use the Look Up tab when I encounter an unfamiliar term.
